about.title: About Hawk Stars
about.short: Hawk Stars is an NGO for Education, Innovation and Social Development, founded in 2022 in Pinhel, in Portugal's interior. Through non-formal education, Erasmus+ mobility and social innovation projects, it works to turn the interior into a place of talent and opportunity.
about.long: Hawk Stars – Association for Education, Innovation and Social Development was founded in 2022 in Pinhel, after the founders of the youth association EuroHawk (2015–2018) sent five trucks of humanitarian aid to Ukraine. Since then it has involved 282 young people and youth workers from 24 nationalities in international mobility projects, hosted Erasmus+ training courses in Pinhel and Almeida, and built a network of 32 international partners. Its flagship project is the Global Village – International Training Center: a hub for training, coworking, incubation, technology and culture in Pinhel's historic centre. Motto: Think Global, Act Local.
